units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 70b:11">Kidd. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>כל כהן שיש לו ע׳ פ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="B00198"><he>בו</he></cite>) any priest that is insolent is surely one of them (the slaves of Pashḥur).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 70b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>אם ראית כהן בע׳ מ׳ וכ׳</he> if thou seest an insolent priest, do not criticise him, for it is said (<cite ref="Hosea 4:4">Hos. IV, 4</cite>) &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 30b">Sabb. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 16b:23">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>שתצילנו מעזי פנים ומע׳ פ׳</he> save us from contact with insolent men and from being insolent; (Rashi: from giving reason for the imputation of spurious descent, a sign of which is insolence).
<cite ref="Taanit 7b:9">Taan. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>כל אדם שיש לו ע׳ פ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="P00402"><he>עזות</he></cite> only), v. supra.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 49b:10">Kidd. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>עשרה קבים ע׳ וכ׳</he> ten measures of insolence have come down into the world, nine of them Meshan took &c.; a. e.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:4">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>ענה אותו ע׳</he> gave him a harsh answer.
